# Borrow a field guide

Create a loan, then inspect its title. These request blocks are executable examples.

```request
{"id":"create-loan","method":"POST","path":"/loans","body":{"title":"Neighborhood Trees"},"status":201,"capture":{"loanId":{"path":"id","type":"number"}}}
```

Read the borrowed book name. This authored example deliberately uses an outdated field.

```request
{"id":"read-loan","method":"GET","path":"/loans/{{loanId}}","status":200,"assert":{"bookName":"Neighborhood Trees"}}
```

```request
{"id":"return-loan","method":"DELETE","path":"/loans/{{loanId}}","status":200,"assert":{"returned":true}}
```
